selection: Higher macro-average top1 and NDCG on the two observed repositories, without per-query top-five recall regressions. Express gains four first results; OpenClaw loses one.
holdout_acceptance: No per-query recall@5 regressions; aggregate top1 and NDCG@5 must not decline versus ADR 0008 incumbent. Reject on execution/provider failures. No tuning after holdout.
